assistant.title: RuralCare AI Assistant
assistant.disclaimerText: The AI Assistant provides general healthcare guidance and facility navigation only. It is not a doctor and does not provide medical diagnosis or treatment advice. For emergencies, call 108.
assistant.welcomeMessage:
Hello! I am the RuralCare AI Assistant. I can help you find the right type of government healthcare facility based on your needs, and provide general healthcare guidance.

What healthcare help do you need today?
assistant.qFever: I have a fever — where should I go?
assistant.qMaternity: Where can I find maternity services?
assistant.qVaccination: My child needs vaccination — which facility?
assistant.qEmergency: Is there a 24-hour emergency facility nearby?
assistant.qTB: Where can I get TB treatment?
assistant.qMedicines: How do I find available medicines?
assistant.placeholder: Ask about a symptom, facility type, or service...
assistant.errorResponse: Sorry, I could not get a response right now. Please try again, or use the facility search to find a healthcare facility near you.
assistant.footerNote: Responses are powered by AI and are for guidance only. Always consult a qualified doctor.
